ddp.description: One preformatted Data Download Program package of a Board release as CSV, reshaped to one row per series and date: date, series, value, value_flag (ND = no data), description, unit, multiplier, currency, unique_id. The value times multiplier is in unit (Currency x 1000000 = millions of dollars).

rel.desc: release code: G19 (consumer credit), Z1 (Financial Accounts), SLOOS, SCOOS, H8 (bank balance sheets), H6 (money stock), H15 (interest rates), H41 (Fed balance sheet), G17 (industrial production), G20 (finance companies), CHGDEL (charge-offs and delinquencies), DSR / FOR (debt service ratios), CP (commercial paper), H10 (exchange rates), H3, E2, PRATES. Optional with a catalog package alias

package.desc: the package: its 32-character id, its title as listed by ddp_packages (exact, or a unique start or part: 'Consumer Credit Outstanding (S.A.)', 'S1M.b (Q)'), or a catalog alias (g19_all, g19_sa, sloos, z1_b101 ...)

series_ids.desc: optional list of series codes (the Time Period header, e.g. DTCTL.M) or unique identifiers (G19/CCOUT/DTCTL.M) to keep

lastobs.desc: optional: only the last N observations of each series (applied by the pack to the whole package)

from.desc: optional first date: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYQn (applied by the pack)

to.desc: optional last date, inclusive: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYQn

ddp_packages.description: The preformatted packages of one release (scraped from its Choose page): package_title, package (id), listed (format, default observations, size).

rel.desc: release code, e.g. G19, Z1 (435 packages), SLOOS

z1.description: One table of the Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1) from the Board's bulk CSV zip (8 MB, current release), one row per series and date: date (1945:Q4 ... 2026:Q2), series, value (millions of dollars unless the units say otherwise), value_flag (ND), description, line, units, table, table_published.

table.desc: table code, new style (S1M.b, S1M.s, F3.2.s, S1311.s) or the published name it replaced (B.101, L.101, F.101, L.210, L.106); z1_tables lists both

series_ids.desc: optional list of series codes to keep, e.g. FL152000005.Q (with or without the .Q)

start.desc: optional first date, YYYY or YYYY:Qn

end.desc: optional last date, YYYY or YYYY:Qn

z1_tables.description: Z.1 table list: new (the code the zip and DDP use, e.g. S1M.b), old (the published table name, e.g. B.101), title.

scf_chart.description: Survey of Consumer Finances interactive chart data, 1989-2025 (triennial): one row per survey year and group (Category), one column per item (Before_Tax_Income, Net_Worth, Assets, Financial_Assets, Retirement_Accounts, Primary_Residence, Debt, Credit_Card_Balances, Education_Installment_Loans ...). Mean and median in thousands of 2025 dollars; have = percent of families holding the item.

group.desc: family grouping: all, agecl (age of head), edcl (education), famstruct, housecl (owner/renter), inccat (income percentile), nwcat (net worth percentile), occat1 / occat2 (work status / occupation), racecl4 (race and ethnicity)

stat.desc: median or mean (among families that hold the item, thousands of 2025 dollars) or have (percent of families holding it)

scf_table.description: One sheet of the 2025 SCF published summary tables (1989-2025), as a raw grid: row (sheet row number) and c1..cN (cells as stored); the sheets have titles and multi-row headers, so read the grid, do not expect tidy columns.

file.desc: real = thousands of 2025 dollars; nominal = dollars of each survey year

sheet.desc: sheet name, e.g. 'Table 4' (net worth by family characteristics), 'Table 1 01-25' (income); a wrong name lists the sheets

g19_all.name: G.19 Consumer Credit Outstanding - All
g19_all.description: monthly since 1943: totals, revolving, nonrevolving, SA and NSA levels, percent changes, holders (millions of dollars)

g19_sa.name: G.19 Consumer Credit Outstanding (S.A.)
g19_sa.description: seasonally adjusted totals and percent changes (headline)

g19_terms.name: G.19 Terms of Credit
g19_terms.description: interest rates on credit cards, auto loans, personal loans; loan terms

g19_holders_nsa.name: G.19 Major Holders (N.S.A.)
g19_holders_nsa.description: consumer credit by holder: banks, finance companies, credit unions, federal government (student loans), ...

sloos.name: Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey - All chart data
sloos.description: quarterly net percentages of banks tightening standards and reporting stronger demand, by loan type

scoos.name: Senior Credit Officer Opinion Survey - all active questions

z1_b101.name: Z.1 S1M.b (Q) Households and nonprofit organizations balance sheet (B.101)
z1_b101.description: quarterly balance sheet, net worth, millions of dollars

z1_l101.name: Z.1 S1M.s (Q) Households and nonprofit organizations levels (L.101)

z1_f101.name: Z.1 S1M.t (Q) Households and nonprofit organizations transactions (F.101)

h15_treasury_cmt.name: H.15 Treasury Constant Maturities
h15_treasury_cmt.description: daily market yields, 1-month to 30-year (also in treasury-yields and fred)

h6_monthly.name: H.6 M1, M2 and other release data, monthly

h8_all_banks_sa.name: H.8 All Commercial Banks, SA (Weekly)
h8_all_banks_sa.description: assets and liabilities of commercial banks, weekly, seasonally adjusted

g17_summary.name: G.17 Summary Table Data
g17_summary.description: industrial production and capacity utilization summary

chgdel_rates_all.name: Charge-off rates/All banks
chgdel_rates_all.description: quarterly charge-off rates by loan type, percent

prates_daily.name: Policy Rates - Daily
prates_daily.description: interest on reserve balances, discount rate, ON RRP rate
